messages.subject: 3' QuantSeq FWD (quantseq-3'mrna-sequencing/) from lexogen
parts:
HI Wie Shi,
                  I recently got some RNA seq data which is carried out with 3' QuantSeq FWD (quantseq-3'mrna-sequencing/) from lexogen. I would like to use subread alignment and feature count for counting for this analysis. Since these data were generated with a different protocol, could you please give me some suggestions for taking care of the parameters for subread alignment and featureCounts. What commands line should be precisely used for alignment and quantification.
I am waiting for your kind reply with anticipation.
Kind regards,
Ami

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: 3' QuantSeq FWD (quantseq-3'mrna-sequencing/) from lexogen
parts: What is the difference between '3' QuantSeq FWD' protocol and the standard Illumina sequencing protocol? This is the first time I heard of this protocol. If it is a stranded protocol, then you should set the strandness parameter in featureCounts accordingly. For read mapping I dont think there are any specific parameters you need to change.
